question: Which of the following enzymes can be considered a good marker of drug-induced hemolytic anemia ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Glucose-6 phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PDH) -> Deficiency in G6PDH enzyme -> Drug-induced oxidative stress -> Hemolytic anemia -> Good marker of drug-induced hemolytic anemia -> 95%
CHAIN: Lactate dehydrogenase -> Released from damaged red blood cells -> Hemolysis -> Marker of hemolytic anemia -> Possible marker of drug-induced hemolytic anemia -> 80%
